note: Go Camp Tennessee campground on a wooded peninsula in Beech Lake near Lexington, run under an agreement with the Beech River Watershed Development Authority. Only the two lakeside sites, L15 and L16, are on the shore. Swim beach and camp store; the boat ramp needs a Lake Use Permit. --Claude
summary: Beech Lake: Go Camp page (headless), Campspot record/lists/quotes/map/photo, Esri, 3DEP, Google read. $28-40 + $5 per-stay surcharge (stored 33-45 had the surcharge folded in); standing 2-night minimum confirmed on every 2027 date; season 2027 4/2-11/14 per Campspot; 103 sites (Go Camp), ~44 sold online. Lakefront kept on two sites L15/L16 (~14 m, ~2.8 m above the water, open understory). Point Loop not sold online, roofed RVs + docks there: long-stay share unresolved. Google 4.0 (110).
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront kept, on two sites only: Campspot '30 AMP & WATER LAKESIDE' L15 and L16, sold by the night ($40). The shore pad at ~35.6941,-88.4170 (3DEP 143.05 m) is ~14 m from the lake surface (140.27 m) over a gentle ~12 degree bank (2.8 m), open understory under scattered trees in the operator's January 2025 photo; the second shore pad ~35.6938,-88.4171. Kayak test: borderline (2.8 m, but gentle, not ~30 degrees). The canopy is full in summer imagery. If AWH reads 'under canopy' strictly this is lakeview.

MIN STAY: standing 2-night minimum (booking.min_stay 'always', already stored and marked under AWH's 2026-10-10 rule) - Campspot answered 'There is a 2 night minimum over the requested period of time' on 2027-04-06, 05-11, 06-08 (Tue) and 06-12 (Sat). Not 3+, so not a drop.

LONG-STAY (unresolved, not a drop yet): Go Camp says 103 campsites; Campspot sells ~44 RV sites + 2 cabins. The ~45-site Point Loop at the tip and several Lake Loop shore pads are not sold online, and Esri shows RVs there with roofs over them and a row of boat slips. Nothing read says seasonal; nightly share at least ~43%. Google 4.0 over 110 reviews.
PRICE GATE: passes ($40 high + $5 per stay).

FEES CHANGE: stored 33-45 = Campspot's one-night average with the $5 per-stay surcharge folded in; site charges are 28-40, surcharge now in reservation_fee. A 23-ft rig fits water-only P06 (26 ft) but not P23 (20 ft).

OWNERSHIP question: Go Camp page says 'Partnership agreement with the Beech River Watershed Development' (BRWDA, a state-created agency that owns Beech Lake); operator is Tennessee Valley Hospitality / RRM CLM Services LLC. Stored private (concessionaire-run). Not changed.
